descriptions.notStarted: You perform a favor for #Robby Fray#k so he would agree to cater the party, but when you go to turn it in, he screams in dismay. It seems like you'll have to do him another favor...
descriptions.inProgress: Uh oh. Without his Secret Recipe, Robby Fray can't bear to keep living, let alone cater a party. Hopefully you can find his Secret Recipe before somebody else nabs it.\r\nIt should be with the Doll Claw Games on the 3rd-4th floor of the Shopping Center, right?\r\n
descriptions.completed: Whew! Finally, you convinced Robby Fray, the seven star chef, to cater the party. Report the good news to #bLana#k.
